enforcer_big_body.name: Big Body
enforcer_big_body.description: The crew's wall. Absorbs punishment so everyone else can keep fighting.

enforcer_ghost.name: Ghost
enforcer_ghost.description: Controlled and precise. Presses advantages without taking unnecessary risks.

enforcer_mamas_boy.name: Mama's Boy
enforcer_mamas_boy.description: Still proving himself. Hits hardest when someone he cares about is in danger.

wheelman_slick.name: Slick
wheelman_slick.description: The escape plan. At her best when the whole crew moves together.

wheelman_grinder.name: Grinder
wheelman_grinder.description: Grinds through. Keeps the pressure up long after others would quit.

wheelman_bonnie.name: Bonnie
wheelman_bonnie.description: Patches problems fast — vehicles, people, plans falling apart.

hacker_byte.name: Byte
hacker_byte.description: Maximum damage, minimum survivability. Stay behind someone bigger.

hacker_hacktivist.name: Hacktivist
hacker_hacktivist.description: Disrupts enemy systems and morale. Fights smarter, not harder.

hacker_skeez.name: Skeez
hacker_skeez.description: High damage wrapped in a con. Works best when the enemy underestimates him.

street_rat_slink.name: Slink
street_rat_slink.description: First in, first out. Maps the room before anyone knows there is one.

street_rat_vex.name: Vex
street_rat_vex.description: Hits from angles you didn't see coming. Gone before you can respond.

street_rat_mouse.name: Mouse
street_rat_mouse.description: Fastest on the boulevard. Slips through gaps and takes what the crew needs.
